title: A two-point convexity inequality
statement:
Let $r, s \in \bbr$ satisfy $0 \le r \le s \le 1$, put $c = \sqrt{r/s}$, and let $t \in [0,1]$. Then
\[
  (1+t)^r - (1-t)^r \;\ge\; c\bigl((1+ct)^s - (1-ct)^s\bigr).
\]
replaced:
Let $0 \le r \le s \le 1$, $c = \sqrt{r/s}$ and $t \in [0,1]$. Then
\[
  (1+t)^r - (1-t)^r \;\ge\; c\bigl((1+ct)^s - (1-ct)^s\bigr).
\]
